Commentary.Commentary: We are back for England's reply. The players are out in the middle. Jason Roy and Jos Buttler are the openers for the English side. Kagiso Rabada to start with the ball.
... THE CHASE ...

England were decent in patches as they were not that effective while using the longer part of the ground and the slower balls. The spinners weren't consistent as well and everyone was taken to the cleaners by South Africa. They could have been tactically more mature but were sloppy in lines and didn't create many chances. Chris Jordan's last over has just helped momentum shift to the hosts' side and the pitch isn't that hard to bat on as well. The team who 24 hours ago scored more than 200 themselves, will be itching to get out and put on a show. Stay tuned as the chase is coming right after a short break.

That was some serious batting from the Proteas! The pitch was a belter to bat on and South Africa have done really well to get past the 200-mark. Apart from the first over, there was nothing for the bowlers and South Africa made the most of it. After the wicket of de Kock. Both Reeza Hendricks and Rilee Rossouw started scoring at a quick rate. The former fell after his fifty but the latter continued on his merry way. He remains unbeaten on 96 but has pushed his team into a commendable position here.

That last over could prove to be very crucial as South Africa will feel they are 10-15 runs short despite scoring more than 200. Nothing should be taken away from the man of the hour Rilee Rossouw, who came agonizingly close to his ton but missed out by just four runs. Still, what an excellent innings from Rilee Rossouw! Due to his performance, South Africa find themselves in a good position.

What an over from Chris Jordan! This has been an exceptional last over from the fast bowler as he concedes just four runs in it! He serves this on a yorker length and wide outside off, Rilee Rossouw comes across the wicket and looks to guide it fine but misses. Jos Buttler has his gloves off and throws the ball back to the bowler as Tristan Stubbs dives back to get into his crease at the non-striker's end. Dot ball to end an exhibition of batting!
This is on a good length and on off, Rilee Rossouw gets down the wicket and swings. Gets an outside edge that flies towards deep backward point. He runs hard to keep strike and they complete a brace.
Goes full once again and angles this into the pads, Tristan Stubbs clips this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
That is another dot ball! This one was really close to a wicket! Chris Jordan goes full and just outside off, Tristan Stubbs swings and misses as the ball swishes past the off pole.
Chris Jordan bangs this in short and in line with the stumps, Tristan Stubbs looks to pull and misses. An important dot ball!
Chris Jordan serves a low full toss outside off, Rilee Rossouw knocks this to deep cover for a single. Rilee Rossouw is just one hit away from a century.
Sam Curran goes full and into the stumps, Rilee Rossouw knocks this down to long on for a single and keeps strike.
WIDE! Sam Curran bangs it in short and angling down leg. Called wide by the umpire.

Full delivery pitching outside leg and angling down. Tristan Stubbs looks to work this leg side and misses. Hits his pads and rushes across for a single. Sam Curran gets to the ball and takes a shy at the stumps. Would have been well short of he had it.
This is short and angling into the batter. Rilee Rossouw pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is full as well in line with the stumps. Tristan Stubbs mistimes his loft towards long on and gets a single.

SIX! Tristan Stubbs joins the party! Sam Curran bowls full outside off, Tristan Stubbs has room to swing his arms and lifts it over the long off boundary for a huge hit! Fifty run partnership comes up between these two.
Sam Curran begins with a short delivery outside off. Rilee Rossouw pulls and gets a top edge into the vacant deep backward square leg region.
Sam Curran to bowl the penultimate over.

Chris Jordan bangs this in short and outside off, Tristan Stubbs looks to pull this but mistimes it straight toward long on. Moeen Ali over runs the ball but gets back to stop it from running across the boundary. The batters complete two runs.
Misses his yorker once more as he bowls a full toss outside off. Rilee Rossouw can not make the most of this as he hits it towards long on for a single.
Chris Jordan goes full outside off, Rilee Rossouw tries to get across and scoop this over fine leg. Misses the ball as it goes through to the keeper.
FOUR! Rilee Rossouw is in attack mode all innings! He does not time this well but powers the full toss over the mid off fielder for another four runs!

SIX! Rilee Rossouw has muscled this over the boundary! Chris Jordan attempts the yorker and misses his length as he serves a full toss outside off. Rilee Rossouw lifts this over the long off fence for a biggie!
Chris Jordan begins with a low full toss outside off, Rilee Rossouw is well across the stumps as he works it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
This is full and angling into the pads, Rilee Rossouw clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Reece Topley bowls a low full toss wide outside off, Tristan Stubbs hits this wide of long on but settles for a single.
Full, slower and outside off, pushed wide of long off for a couple.
Bangs a bouncer now on middle. Stubbs looks to pull but misses.
Leg bye! On the hips this time. Rossouw fails to get his bat on it. It goes off the hips to square leg for a leg bye.
In the and safe! A fuller ball, outside off. Stubbs tries to loft it over extra cover but splices his shot, in the air and to deep cover. The ball falls well ahead of the man there. One.

FOUR! The knock does not seem to be slowing Rilee Rossouw here! Richard Gleeson his missing his length here as he bowls another low full toss wide outside off, Rilee Rossouw reaches out and works this over the fielder for a boundary to backward point. 16 runs of the over!
Halt in play! Rilee Rossouw gets hit underneath the grill. He is in pain. The physio is out going through some protocols. Rossouw looks fine to continue.
This is a yorker served wide outside off, Rilee Rossouw goes across to work this leg side and gets really low. The ball gets an edge of his bat and hit him under the helmet. Looks like that has hurt!
FOUR! This is proving to be another expensive over! This is a low full toss outside off, Rilee Rossouw lifts it over the mid on fielder for another four runs.
SIX! This is massive! Rilee Rossouw is exhibiting some power here! He is using the short boundary well and he powers a full delivery outside off over the long on fence for a maximum!
Richard Gleeson goes a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Tristan Stubbs pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Richard Gleeson begins with a low full toss outside off, Rilee Rossouw powers this towards deep square leg for a single.
A slower length ball on leg. Rilee Rossouw bends and scoops it to fine leg for a single. 11 runs and a wicket of the over.
Very full this and outside off. Rilee Rossouw fails to jam it out. Rilee is not happy with himself. A bit of bat and it could run away to third man.
FOUR MORE! Short in length and down leg. Rilee Rossouw skips down and pulls it hard behind square on the leg side for a boundary. 150 up for the Proteas.
FOUR! Deft touch! Full ball, outside off. Rilee Rossouw opens the face of the bat and guides it through backward point, in the gap for four. Pierced the two fielder very nicely.
Shorter and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Tristan Stubbs makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jordon strikes at a crucial time! This is on a length and outside off, slow as well. Heinrich Klaasen waits and tries to slap it away but it goes off the cue end of the bat and to cover where Dawid Malan tracksback and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: This one is on the pads, it is flicked to fine leg for a single.
Two more! Slower ball, full and on middle. Klaasen bunts it to deep mid-wicket for another couple.
Fuller and on middle. Klaasen drills it to mid on where Sam Curran lets it through his hands and allows a couple.

FIFTY for Rilee Rossouw! His third fifty in T20I! good knock from him! Length and on leg. Rilee Rossouw helps it to short fine leg for a single. A great comeback from Rilee Rossouw after missing 6 years of international cricket.
A widish yorker, outside off. Rilee Rossouw fails to squeeze it out. Good bowling.
Slower one on the pads. Klaasen nudges it to the longer side to mid-wicket and Topley gives a chase to keep it down to one.
Shorter and on middle. Klaasen wrists it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Tossed up, googly on middle. Klaasen eases it to long on for a couple of runs.

SIX! This one has been dispatched! Adil Rashid flights this full outside off, Heinrich Klaasen stands in his pace and powers it over long off for a huge hit! Heinrich Klaasen is not going to be hanginf aorund.
This is a fraction short and angled into the pads, Rilee Rossouw makes room and hits it towards cover. A misfield allows a single.
FOUR! Two boundaries in a row! This one has been edged past the keeper. Adil Rashid serves a googly from a shorter length. Rilee Rossouw swings hard and gets the ball to third man for a boundary!
FOUR! Rilee Rossouw executes the shot to perfection! This is full outside off, Rilee Rossouw reverse sweeps this past the backward point fielder for a boundary to deep backward point!
Richard Gleeson serves this a fraction short outside off, Heinrich Klaasen hits this towards point on a bounce. The crowd gets excited as they think it is a catch.
FOUR! Short in length and on middle. Klaasen pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Wide! This is full and down the leg side. Klaasen misses his flick.
Length and outside off. Rilee Rossouw drops it to point for a single.
Heinrich Klaasen walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Superb catch from Jonny Bairstow! Short of a length and on middle. It is there to be hit as Reeza Hendricks whacks it to deep square leg. At one moment it looked like he cleared the fielder there but Jonny Bairstow there takes the catch and holds onto it despite his momentum taking his towards the ropes. A brilliant effort from him.
Commentary.Howout: c Jonny Bairstow b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and on off. Rilee Rossouw lofts it to long off for a run.
Wide! This is way outside off. Rilee Rossouw leaves it alone.
Full and on the pads. Reeza Hendricks drills it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Dropped! On a length and on the pads. Reeza Hendricks tries to play it past short fine leg but fails to get elevation and Richard Gleeson there dives to his right and gets his hand to it but fails to stop it. A single.
On a length and on off. Reeza Hendricks works it through covers for two more. Fifty for Reeza Hendricks! A matured knock from Reeza.
Length ball, outside off, it is hit to mid off for a quick single.
Reeza Hendricks takes a single as he hits this length ball to point.
Another length ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks drives it through covers for two more.
Two runs! Length and outside off, pushed through covers for a brace.

This has been an eventful ball! Chris Jordan serves a short delivery angling down leg, Rilee Rossouw looks to pull but it seems like he misses as the ball goes through to the keeper. There is a huge appeal and the umpire shouts not out! Rilee Rossouw was making his way out but decided to hang around after he heard the umpire. Jos Buttler reviewed immediately and UltraEdge shows that there is some glove on this. But wait a minute! They are checking if the catch has been taken cleanly and the third umpire reckons it bounces before getting into the gloves. The on-field decision remains and Rilee Rossouw survives.

Drinks! South Africa have scored 100 in 10 overs and are all set for a total above 200. They would love more as there is still power-hitting coming up. England will love for a couple of wickets to stop the run flow.

SIX! Rilee Rossouw is on the charge here! This time he stays in the crease for the length ball outside off and powers it over the long on fence for a maximum! Rilee Rossouw does not connect as well as he had wished but gets six runs thanks to the short straight boundary!

This as been slapped down the ground! Chris Jordan serves this on a good length outside off, Rilee Rossouw shuffles down the wicket and hits it towards the diving mid on fielder. He just manages to get some hand on it as it runs away to the long on fence for four runs.
Chris Jordan goes really full outside off, Reeza Hendricks manages to get his bat down and knock the ball towards deep cover for a single.
This is one a good length and outside off, Rilee Rossouw looks to slash at it but only manages to tap it down towards point for a single.
Chris Jordan starts off with a short delivery outside off. Reeza Hendricks pulls this to deep square leg for a single.
Chris Jordan to bowl now.
This is full and wide outside off, Rilee Rossouw knocks it back to the bowler.

SIX! That one has been planted out of the stadium! Adil Rashid flights this full outside off, Rilee Rossouw charges down the wicket and lifts it over the long off fence for a biggie! Rilee Rossouw has made a reputation of being very dangerous and he is showing it here!
This is full on middle and off, Reeza Hendricks works this towards mid-wicket for a single.
This one is short and angling into the batter. Rilee Rossouw gets tucked in for space and nudges it towards square leg for a single.
This is full and angling into the pads, Reeza Hendricks tucks this towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! What a shot from Reeza Hendricks! This is full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks lifts this toward deep cover for a boundary! Reeza Hendricks looks in great touch in this series.
A loopy ball on middle. Hendricks flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, kept out.
SIX! THUMPED! Fuller and on middle. Hendricks comes down the track and hammers it straight down for a biggie.
Too full and on off. Rilee Rossouw reverse sweeps it to short third man for one.
Tossed up on off, it bounces more. Rilee Rossouw stays back to defend and does so off the higher part of the blade to point.
Angling on the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for one.

Adil Rashid goes full once again outside off, Reeza Hendricks sweeps hard towards deep square leg. The fielder stops the ball at the boundary and parries it away from his teammate. They take three runs in the process.
This is full outside off, Rilee Rossouw sweeps this to deep backward square leg for a single.
This is a fraction short and pitching on middle, Reeza Hendricks works this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Serves another googly on off, Rilee Rossouw places this wide of long off for a single.
Beaten! Adil Rashid bowls a googly full on middle, Rilee Rossouw looks to fend and gets beaten on the outside edge as it just misses the off pole.
Adil Rashid begins with a full delivery outside off, Reeza Hendricks knocks it to long off for a single.
Adil Rashid is into the attack now.

FOUR! This one has been beautifully timed and placed even more perfectly! Richard Gleeson goes outside off now on a good length. Rilee Rossouw gets a stride forward and hits this past cover for a boundary to deep cover! 13 runs of the over. South Africa are 58 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!

SIX! This one has been connected! Richard Gleeson continues bowling down leg and on a full length. Rilee Rossouw does not miss out on this as he lifts the ball over the wide fine leg fence for a maximum!
WIDE! Strays down leg on a fuller length. Rilee Rossouw looks to heave this leg side and misses. Called wide by the umpire.
Goes a fraction fuller outside off, Rilee Rossouw strokes this straight to mid off.
Richard Gleeson continues bowling on a good length and on a leg stump line. Rilee Rossouw looks to pull but is not short enough and gets hit on his legs.
This is on a good length outside off, Reeza Hendricks taps the ball down into the pitch and rushes across for a quick single.
Richard Gleeson begins with a full delivery on middle and leg, Rilee Rossouw works this towards mid on for a single.
Leg bye! Just five of the over then! Good comeback after going for a four early on. This one is on the pads. Rilee Rossouw fails to flick it away and it rolls to square leg off the pads.
Four dots in a row! Length and on off. Rilee Rossouw taps it to point.
Length and on middle, nudged to the right of mid-wicket who makes a diving stop.
Fuller and on off, pushed to covers.
Beauty! On a length and on middle, extra bounce here and it straightens up. Rilee Rossouw is squared up as he tries to defend and the ball bounces over the middle pole.
FOUR! Poor delivery! This is full and sliding down the leg side. Rilee Rossouw just helps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle. Rilee Rossouw tickles it to short fine leg for a single.
Rilee Rossouw is the new man at the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Moeen Ali gets the breakthrough! Quinton de Kock was looking good but holes one out. Ali goes 'round the wicket and serves a flatter ball, outside off, drifting in. Quinton de Kock is through to the shot as he swings his bat across but fails to connect cleanly and the ball lobs to Jason Roy at mid on who takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, Hendricks hits it to long on for one more.
Fuller and on middle, this one drifts in. Quinton de Kock tries to go over covers but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Greets Ali with a boundary! Flatter, slower and outside off. Hendricks hangs back and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
This one is at 115 clicks, on middle, it is worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one, full and outside off, guided to point.
Length and on leg. Quinton de Kock turns it to square leg and gets to the other side.
On middle, it is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! South Africa changing the gear now! Curran serves it on the pads. Hendricks stays back and whacks it behind square on the leg side for four more. 18 off the last four balls.
SIX! Hendricks made it look so easy! On a length and on middle. Hendricks gets inside the line of the ball and slams it across over mid-wicket for a biggie.

FOUR! Two in a row! 14 runs off the over! Good one for the Proteas! This one is full and outside off. Quinton de Kock again chips it firmly over covers, clears the infield and collects another boundary.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase! This one is in the slot, full and on middle. Quinton de Kock stays back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Way outside off again. Quinton de Kock tries to play at it but misses. Wided.
Length and on top of off. Quinton de Kock goes away and lofts it over covers. The outfield is slow and the ball falls safe well over the fielder. Two runs.
Wide! Shorter and outside off, moving away. Quinton de Kock makes room and tries to slash it away but was out of his reach. A wide given.
A huge swing and a miss! On a length and outside off. Quinton de Kock has a wild swing but fails to connect.
Short of a length and on the hips at 129 kph. Hendricks nudges it to square leg for a single.
Length ball, just outside off. Quinton de Kock steers it to third man and rotates the strike.
Reece Topley will share the attack from the other end.
This is full and outside off, slower ball. Hendricks looks to drive but gets deceived by the lack of pace.
Touch fuller and around off, hint of nip in. Hendricks inner edges it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On a length and outside off. Quinton de Kock cuts it uppishly through point for a run.
Hendricks is underway as well! Length and on the pads, Hendricks flicks it past square leg for one run.
South Africa and Quinton de Kock are underway! Outward movement again, this is full and on off, it is pushed to mid off for a quick single.
A length ball, outside off, a bit of out swing. Quinton de Kock shoulders arms to it.
We are all set to resume. Quinton de Kock and Reeza Hendricks have come out to the middle to open the innings. Sam Curran will begin proceedings with the new ball.

South Africa (Unchanged playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Rilee Rossouw, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller (C), Tristan Stubbs, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
England (Unchanged playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Moeen Ali, Liam Livingstone, Sam Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley, Richard Gleeson.
TOSS - England have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

South Africa on the other hand, will hope that their top order starts to contribute heavily. They will be thrilled with the performance of Tristan Stubbs who played a gem of an innings last game. Their bowling needs to be much more disciplined if they are to win this game and the spinners will need to be much more economical. The biggest factor for their loss in the last game was their fielding which let them down heavily. Several dropped catches marred their bowling performance and will be looking to rectify that aspect of their game. As long as the rain plays no part in this contest, we are in for a wonderful match up. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit…
